environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 bare-metal host with AppArmor profile 'oauth-api-confined' loaded in enforce mode. The profile grants read access to /etc/oauth/client_secrets.json and append access to /var/log/oauth/tokens.log but DENIES all network connect operations except to 127.0.0.1 and the internal metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254). The profile also includes a 'deny network dgram' rule preventing UDP (DNS) to external resolvers. The host uses systemd-resolved with a local stub resolver that only resolves entries in /etc/hosts and the internal .contoso.com zone via a private Route53 resolver endpoint. External domain resolution (including attacker-controlled subdomains like evil-app.contoso.com.attacker.net) will fail with NXDOMAIN since the stub resolver has no upstream forwarder configured for non-.contoso.com zones. The AppArmor profile was generated via aa-genprof during a supervised training run and has been in enforce mode for 90 days without modification.

config.apparmor_network_rules: deny network dgram, allow tcp connect to 127.0.0.1 and 169.254.169.254 only
config.dns_resolver: systemd-resolved stub, no upstream forwarder, resolves only /etc/hosts and .contoso.com via private Route53 inbound endpoint
config.filesystem_rules: read /etc/oauth/client_secrets.json, append /var/log/oauth/tokens.log, deny all other file access
